title: Stop shared Balanced scanning at the final start before terminal Partition
question: Can a terminal Partition perform final-child validation while locating its keys and reduce Run time?
summary: Balanced(2) halves the frame visits and saves 62.1 MB in actual tracked reads. Balanced(1) opens no scan reader and saves 124.1 MB. All six paired Runs improved.

workloads: Formula-free Balanced(1 or 2) followed by terminal Partition, 600,003 rows, 256 MiB and 4 MiB CSV cap.

validation.summary: Independent exact fields, CSV hashes, lineage, membership, caps, marker and workspace checks. Corrupt final frames and cancellation fail in focused engine coverage.

limitations: Measured on one bundled Chromium WSL2 profile. Unexpected private-spool damage in a deferred frame surfaces during subsequent Partition.
exclusions: Other following operations, calculated jobs, experimental constant Partition, native elapsed time and physical disk I/O.
